text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In honor of her outstanding performance, Taiki Shuttle receives the URA award for best sprinter. But the Umamusume of the Year is none other than Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the unfortunate results, Taiki refuses to give up. Citing my faith in her speed, she declares that she'll be the next Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to conquer all the G1 races—determined to make her speed and power known to as many people as she can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our ambition renewed, we challenge ourselves with the Yasuda Kinen—the race to crown the spring King of the Mile!
